6662.title: Package artifacts omit MIT licensing
6662.rootCauseOneLine: Both published package manifests omit license metadata and their package roots do not supply the repository MIT notice.
6662.proposedFix: Declare MIT in both package manifests, supply synchronized repository license notices in both package roots, and verify the packed artifacts before a new release.
6662.caveats: Packaging changes are excluded from autopilot fixes. SDK 0.6.79 and specific third-party scanner classifications were not tested. Whole-repository build failed on an unrelated missing SDK runtime prerequisite; focused SDK build passed. Complete audit and clean-rerun output are inline in the report.
